title: Zwambag 2016: L4/L5 moment, lumbar flexion and trunk inclination at lumbar ES inactivation, with torso counterweights
condition: standing flexion; 0, 5, 10, 15 lb counterweight pulling the torso up at T5

quantity.name: critical point of lumbar ES inactivation
quantity.definition: external L4/L5 extensor moment (Nm, inverse dynamics), lumbar flexion (T12-S1, deg) and trunk inclination (T12 vs horizontal from standing, deg) at the critical point; mean +/- SEM (Fig 2 caption: 'Mean (+ SEM)'; Zwambag 2020 Table 1 labels the same moments mean +/- SEM)

how_to_simulate: Scale to protocol.subject_model (male, 25 y, 181 cm, 82 kg)
Quasi-static trunk flexion to full flexion (T12/S1 ~53 deg)
External load: an upward cable force at ~T5 equal to the counterweight (0, 22.2, 44.5, 66.7 N) via an overhead pulley; no hand load
Output: lumbar flexion, trunk inclination and the external L4/L5 moment at the instant the model's lumbar ES activation reaches ~0 (critical point)
protocol.notes: Surface EMG bilateral: lumbar ES at L3, thoracic ES at T9, latissimus at T12, RA 2 cm lateral to navel, EO 14 cm lateral to midline, IO 2 cm medial/inferior to ASIS; fine-wire multifidus 1.5 cm lateral to L1 and L4 spinous processes. EMG high-pass 100 Hz, rectified, 2.5 Hz low-pass, %MVIC. Critical point = LES activity crosses mean + 2 SD of its quiet (full-flexion) period for > 20 ms. Lumbar flexion = T12 vs S1 rigid bodies (0 = neutral standing); trunk inclination = T12 rigid body vs horizontal (0 = standing). L4/L5 moment from a 2-D dynamic bottom-up linked-segment model (force plate). Task: flex to full flexion in 3 s, hold 3 s, return in 3 s; counterweights 0/5/10/15 lb (0/2.3/4.5/6.8 kg) on a cable attached at ~T5 over an overhead pulley (reduces the flexion moment). Data pooled left/right (no side difference).

data.x: trunk inclination at CP, all conditions (no effect)

extraction.from: Zwambag 2016 Results Sec 3.1 text (values also plotted in Fig 2)
extraction.uncertainty: the 'sd' field holds the SEM (convert: SD = SEM x sqrt(10))
extraction.check_notes: Re-read Sec 3.1; same values reappear in Zwambag 2020 (rounded: 94/79/66/62 Nm; 51/50.8/49.7/48.6 deg).

pass_rule.rule: |model - mean| <= 1 SD (angles); for SEM-reported data use SD = SEM x sqrt(n)
